matched_control: Same rebuilt ntdll clients, server and graphics stack; control uses installed pre-cache win32u.so. Both select Intel and enable shadows.
preliminary_result: Compared with the installed runner at high-rate input: Word scrolling is similar; Excel 19.15 versus 25.26 region changes/second and 11.04 versus 8.14 CPU seconds; PowerPoint 12.1 versus 13.07. Relative to rebuilt matching clients without the cache, most Excel update-rate gain comes from the rebuilt client, while shared window order reduces CPU use. No matched Windows baseline. Candidate is not deployed.

Explicit WINEARCH=wow64 passes the graphical regression, but selecting it globally breaks this Office configuration; the launcher retains its original mode.

incompatible_wow64_default: Rejected: it passes the 32-bit standalone graphical test but Office window enumeration/startup fails in this configuration. Default launcher mode was restored; normal-mode startup and menu tests pass.

packaging.symlink_base_handling: Build resolves the base directory before copying; a linked staging base stays unmodified. Pristine Soda restored from the checksum-verified pinned archive.

reason: GetWindow API loop improves about 51x, but matched three-round desktop scrolling with detailed traces disabled shows no material throughput or CPU improvement. Word still stalls. Cache and notification batching were removed from source before final packaging; server protocol remains 932.
